CLM-MAT-0026.statement: The 2-inch-round tunable coating generates a power density of 0.48 W/m2 at noon time in ambient condition.

extra_quotes: At night, it produces 26 mW/m2 power in vacuum, outperforming the black emitter by 63%.
Even exposed the ambient with convective loss, the 2-inch-round tunable coating generates power of 0.48 W/m2 at noon time, 14% more than the black absorber of the same size.

The tunable radiative coating covered thermoelectric modules produces open circuit voltages from 433 mV to -62 mV in vacuum and from 300 mV to -51 mV in ambient through 24-hr continuous outdoor tests.

Clearly, the daytime TEG power generation can be significantly degraded by the convection heat loss as well as higher ambient temperature that decreases the temperature differential across the TEG stack.
